description: Mock exam validation evaluation (MOCK-X). Each case is one AI generation over named sources of the `mock_exam` block of tests/fixtures/llm/generation-scenarios.json (synthetic MCQs about the synthetic book-ko fixture), with their passages taken from the page of tests/fixtures/pdfs/book-ko.truth.json each source cites. The fake provider answers with the block's scripted items (deliberate faults: a multi-answer inversion that fails validation, a batch that is unreadable as a whole, an answer cut at the output budget, items whose quote or answer is wrong); the llm provider sends the same synthetic sources and passages to the real model.
